left.text: The two differ in case, length, and person. Both follow the same rule on evidence and pass the same three checks before publishing.

items.value: Site copy uses declarative sentences, sentence-case headings, Title Case button labels, and short captions.
Founder posts are lowercase, terse, and first person. A post that any founder account could have written is not ready to publish.
Both avoid founder clichés such as thrilled to announce and make no claim without a number, a mechanism, or an artifact.
Three checks run before posting: only GT could have written it, it cites concrete evidence, and it supports the reputation for quality.
